summary: Verified iter308 responsive fixes for the statement decoder 'Show full line-item table' and invoice 'What's been charged' sections, plus global page gutter. Both wide tables now render stacked cards <md and aligned tables md+. No horizontal page overflow anywhere on the specified pages at 390/768/1440. However, one item from the change note is INCOMPLETE: the stray ',' placeholder is still visible in the DecoderResultView mobile cards for 'Your share' / 'Gov' when values are null — root cause is DecoderResultView.jsx:13 aud() helper still returns ', ' for null.

ui_bugs.issue: Stray comma still shown for 'Your share' / 'Gov' when the underlying value is null. Visible on statement d5267556-... first item ('Personal care'): renders 'Your share ,' and 'Gov ,' instead of '—'. Root cause: aud() helper at /app/frontend/src/components/DecoderResultView.jsx:13 returns ', ' for null; call sites at lines 424-425 don't null-guard. Also /app/frontend/src/components/DecoderResultView.jsx:580 returns ','. The task change note claims stray ', '/',' → '—' but this path was missed for the mobile cards.

verification_evidence.console_errors_on_changed_pages: Only pre-existing GSI 403 (Google Identity) warnings and Recharts width(-1) warnings — no NEW errors introduced on StatementDetail/DecoderResultView/InvoiceResultView. No blank sections.

action_items: Fix DecoderResultView.jsx: change aud() at line 13 to return '—' for null (or null-guard the two call sites on lines 424-425 like InvoiceResultView does on line 361). Also fix the ',' fallback at DecoderResultView.jsx:580. This will complete the stated ', '/',' → '—' cleanup on the statement mobile card.
critical_code_review_comments: aud() default of ', ' for null is a codebase-wide anti-pattern (also present in StatementLifecycleModals.jsx, statementFields.js, and several AdminPhase*.jsx / AdminUserProfile / AdminPages / AdminSupport / SwitchSettlement pages). Consider centralising a formatMoney helper that returns '—' for null.
InvoiceResultView correctly null-guards at the call site (ln.contribution_amount != null ? aud(...) : '—'); apply the same pattern in DecoderResultView mobile cards.
Responsive-table pattern (md:hidden stacked cards + hidden md:block table) is now consistent across all three wide tables — good pattern to reuse.

success_rate.frontend: 5/6 acceptance criteria pass — full-width gutter, both wide-table responsive layouts, no page overflow, desktop regression, list-page regression all PASS; the '—' cleanup for statement decoder mobile card is INCOMPLETE (stray comma still visible)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The stacked-card fixes for decoder-full-cards and inv1-charges-cards, plus the reduced 12px page gutter, all verified working at 390/768/1440. Only remaining issue is the stray comma placeholder in DecoderResultView mobile cards ('Your share ,'/'Gov ,') caused by aud() returning ', ' for null — see /app/frontend/src/components/DecoderResultView.jsx:13 and lines 424-425. After main agent fixes, re-verify statement d5267556-57c4-4925-90c7-13eca0ba24f3 first item ('Personal care') on 390 viewport: cards should show 'Your share —' / 'Gov —' instead of commas.
rca of the issue: Statement decoder mobile card stray-comma bug — RCA: /app/frontend/src/components/DecoderResultView.jsx line 13 `function aud(n) { if (n == null) return ', '; ... }` returns a comma-space for null. Lines 424-425 call aud(li.participant_contribution) and aud(li.government_paid) unconditionally, so when those fields are null the rendered text is 'Your share , Gov ,'. Reproduction: login as cathy@example.com, open /app/statements/d5267556-57c4-4925-90c7-13eca0ba24f3 at 390x844, click 'Show full line-item table', observe the first 'Personal care' card. Mitigation: either change the aud() default to '—' (breaking change for other call sites that intentionally show '—') OR null-guard at the call sites in DecoderResultView.jsx:424-425 the same way InvoiceResultView.jsx:361 does.
